# Step 1: Create the 'components' Folder Inside 'src'

#### Course: Build your First Web App with React

## Step 1: Create the 'components' Folder Inside 'src'

Creating a new folder in your local hard drive will obviously won't be a problem for you.

But doing the same thing on our platform might prove to be a bit confusing. So let's start by only creating the components folder first (we'll teach you how to move the files on the next page).

Simply follow the steps below:

1. Go to the Explorer tab on the code editor.
2. Click on the three vertical dots icon besides src.
3. Select the New folder option.
4. Name your folder as components and press the Enter or Return key.

![Creating a new folder](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Your folder's ready, so it's time to move the component files to it. Let's deal with that next.
